[Highlight start] Clinical evidence does not show that **N-acetylcysteine (NAC)** reliably prevents or cures alcohol hangovers [Highlight end] , despite popular anecdotal claims.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX7WemFFPFpYzSSzwIk8cz9g1E8Cu09Hd4B-rjQZC49kdc46WQa6iMsJQKm579KnPofSiIrjuJXlLnUKV7wN-kd4pNWvna7b8py_w15UzIa5REMiYS717sNTIX_34M4qynBvXMTMIGDbQ)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQNz_WpFn5BkzFen950IkAuZGBTjcMhSM_uRRyWR3i-4tRjLyyVrXzIdHHSz7D5Q3LWDajEBIj86e38MszeaWN1IMjNsKGMpht_NapzrMe7S2uMzfhhobMW-oVu7d)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESigEBxCJF125YdlgIBKjkyDtlMDV9pDrrzcbzppfO8zJW-2jTBYLLa2ppIOObZTJ3xlVeTrMf1O9TJhNZtlycO8JdqCzUZAOtSVWFO6FckZU0ShxlcJFMh4e_iBm2CU_AALbvxvD9-S7Xyeddpsqn6HkpU3QunjnEEoU3ZleQEGh7mMB2bxKcUvda_PY)

### What the Research Shows

- **Mixed to negative trial results:** A 2024 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled clinical study found that NAC had no significant effect on overall hangover severity, headache, thirst, or oxidative stress markers compared to a placebo. An earlier study also found no overall difference between NAC and placebo across participants, though it noted a potential reduction in nausea and weakness among female participants.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESYgHEIkXXQNz_WpFn5BkzFen950IkAuZGBTjcMhSM_uRRyWR3i-4tRjLyyVrXzIdHHSz7D5Q3LWDajEBIj86e38MszeaWN1IMjNsKGMpht_NapzrMe7S2uMzfhhobMW-oVu7d)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX7WemFFPFpYzSSzwIk8cz9g1E8Cu09Hd4B-rjQZC49kdc46WQa6iMsJQKm579KnPofSiIrjuJXlLnUKV7wN-kd4pNWvna7b8py_w15UzIa5REMiYS717sNTIX_34M4qynBvXMTMIGDbQ)
- **Why people try it:** NAC boosts glutathione (an antioxidant) and can bind to acetaldehyde, a toxic byproduct of alcohol metabolism. Because hangovers involve dehydration, inflammation, poor sleep, and other factors beyond oxidative stress, boosting glutathione alone often does not stop symptoms.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1wQpgciCE7xzu8LU5wQEvYOqQ-HkRqoEko4O0UGKmEWiUoSLOfWyWAgy-ofNeS-KA_iZ_T3xvb7eavSuNqmYmv-6FPiJuU1pTf1w2F6VaGdp7qNGRBBv3fRyzrI-i4WJVL3cxJF8JjzCso86nEPMH9Fl2zv-I3gKq4LkAFYgikNA8eJcV73MFwlfMYA2mkNXBYK_WTsbW5E997-m)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbQHEIkXX7WemFFPFpYzSSzwIk8cz9g1E8Cu09Hd4B-rjQZC49kdc46WQa6iMsJQKm579KnPofSiIrjuJXlLnUKV7wN-kd4pNWvna7b8py_w15UzIa5REMiYS717sNTIX_34M4qynBvXMTMIGDbQ)
- **Side effects:** Mild gastrointestinal issues (such as nausea or upset stomach) are the most commonly reported side effects.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESbAHEIkXXecCwPMrMyeYaoeTn_QROPp_mu6WrssnSGsNnlJotYa2NKoQGA4wgTM0A2LHiVRr5V-RlpvDDxJk2J8yqNA_2AZP2lQiyil1SBBUVI8VxnBNrP5wq_aRw8myT07s1akgQbIZpTTaASg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESnAEBxCJF13Qa_y_qxY-JJD1VRkGG0WSzWoNergbdCNjs-tAJfHo0jyXwWqAR1B3yoO9ZJ5iSLXqsqHEgGbZ0sIZqZCW91qfEIGUtMiRo3r0CpI06qAtU9pOIPwYG2gddZojkYNVupGH_f3bB6Li65GFFgThMaXJgoN3KvLG0BdlhpZptPjDPTmMC5wiTMxzWMm-fdI3sscgxkly3Z68)

### Practical Hangover Prevention

- **Pace and hydrate:** Alternate alcoholic drinks with water or electrolyte beverages.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXSTUBqPOgHFpvv6OdQB2BVOdxyfh47Ma6HUJbWRe_q5qEl2LiO1L7Lqp_fQn8hAG8UQG0bl-VGhnDWarpUebE2jiyvAOWuWf-VF7QP2kcjxj3SbKgOW41TPOd8pCOXhiw9L2sfO22YZY-L14mKWa9zg)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESoAEBxCJF1wQpgciCE7xzu8LU5wQEvYOqQ-HkRqoEko4O0UGKmEWiUoSLOfWyWAgy-ofNeS-KA_iZ_T3xvb7eavSuNqmYmv-6FPiJuU1pTf1w2F6VaGdp7qNGRBBv3fRyzrI-i4WJVL3cxJF8JjzCso86nEPMH9Fl2zv-I3gKq4LkAFYgikNA8eJcV73MFwlfMYA2mkNXBYK_WTsbW5E997-m)
- **Eat beforehand:** Having food in your stomach slows alcohol absorption.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXSTUBqPOgHFpvv6OdQB2BVOdxyfh47Ma6HUJbWRe_q5qEl2LiO1L7Lqp_fQn8hAG8UQG0bl-VGhnDWarpUebE2jiyvAOWuWf-VF7QP2kcjxj3SbKgOW41TPOd8pCOXhiw9L2sfO22YZY-L14mKWa9zg)
- **Choose drinks carefully:** Lower-congener options (like clear spirits) may cause milder hangovers than dark liquors or red wine for some people.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXSTUBqPOgHFpvv6OdQB2BVOdxyfh47Ma6HUJbWRe_q5qEl2LiO1L7Lqp_fQn8hAG8UQG0bl-VGhnDWarpUebE2jiyvAOWuWf-VF7QP2kcjxj3SbKgOW41TPOd8pCOXhiw9L2sfO22YZY-L14mKWa9zg)
- **Avoid acetaminophen while drinking:** Combining acetaminophen with alcohol increases liver strain.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESdQHEIkXXSTUBqPOgHFpvv6OdQB2BVOdxyfh47Ma6HUJbWRe_q5qEl2LiO1L7Lqp_fQn8hAG8UQG0bl-VGhnDWarpUebE2jiyvAOWuWf-VF7QP2kcjxj3SbKgOW41TPOd8pCOXhiw9L2sfO22YZY-L14mKWa9zg)
